topics.title: Demonstrate motor skills and movement patterns needed to perform a variety of physical activities

subtopics.title: Demonstrate motor skills and movement patterns needed to perform a variety of physical activities

outcomes.text: Demonstrate recognizable forms of the locomotor skills (walk, run, jump, hop, skip, gallop, leap, slide).
Demonstrate recognizable forms of manipulative skills (throwing, catching, dribbling, passing, volleying, striking, and kicking).
Demonstrate transitions between locomotor skills with recognizable forms.
Demonstrate rhythmic locomotor and non-locomotor movements to a beat.

topics.title: Demonstrate understanding of concepts that apply to the learning and performance of movement

subtopics.title: Demonstrate understanding of concepts that apply to the learning and performance of movement

outcomes.text: Demonstrate understanding of the movement concepts of space, pathways, and speed through movement.
Identify one or more of the critical elements for fundamental manipulative skills (throwing, catching, dribbling, passing, volleying, striking, and kicking).
Use teacher feedback to improve basic motor performance.

topics.title: Demonstrate the knowledge and skills needed to achieve a health-enhancing level of physical activity and fitness

subtopics.title: Demonstrate the knowledge and skills needed to achieve a health-enhancing level of physical activity and fitness

outcomes.text: Identify one or more of the five health-related fitness components (cardiorespiratory endurance, muscular strength, muscular endurance, flexibility, or body composition) and their associated exercises.
Identify opportunities for increased physical activity.
Actively participate in physical education class.

outcomes.text: Demonstrate cooperation by following directions in group settings.

outcomes.text: Identify two or more of the five health-related fitness components (cardiorespiratory endurance, muscular strength, muscular endurance, flexibility, or body composition) and their associated exercises.

outcomes.text: Demonstrate mature form of six or more locomotor skills (walk, run, jump, hop, skip, gallop, leap, slide) using different pathways, levels, or directions.

outcomes.text: Describe the FITT principle and training principles (frequency, intensity, time, type, overload, progression, specificity), and how they affect physical fitness for each of the five health-related fitness components.
